# IBM course data attribution

The original dealership, review, and car-record JSON files in server/database/data/ come from IBM Developer Skills Network's xrwvm-fullstack_developer_capstone repository (Apache-2.0). Source: https://github.com/ibm-developer-skills-network/xrwvm-fullstack_developer_capstone/tree/main/server/database/data

The normalized services/dealership/data/seed.json is modified: it adds UI-only phone/brand labels, computes sentiment using this application's classifier, and marks missing ratings and creation timestamps as null. Original course fields and values are retained. The original source files are unchanged. See IBM_CAPSTONE_LICENSE for the upstream license and copyright notice.
